Free at https://my.shipstatic.com/api-key. Optional: without it, deploys behave like the hosted endpoint (public, claim URL, 3-day expiry). With it, deployments are permanent, the full toolset (custom domains, listing, account-tied ops) unlocks, and rate limits are your own instead of the shared anonymous pools.
environmentVariables.name: SHIP_TOKEN
